title: Preserve entry-state integrity and actual measurement horizons
objective: Preserve entry-state integrity and actual measurement horizons. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: The read-only probe feeds read_json a truncated STATE file and receives None, indistinguishable from absence. It then creates a synthetic activation and calls update_outcomes 168 hours later; the 24h slot receives that 168-hour return. The supplied external harness falsely declares M4 FIXED merely from a measurement_validity token elsewhere.

positive: Only a genuinely missing initial state may use initialization behavior; a corrupt existing state stops before publication.
Fixed-horizon outcomes carry source observation timestamps and are eligible only for their documented measurement interval.
Missing or late endpoint evidence is explicit; raw observations may remain observations without becoming false fixed-horizon outcomes.
negative: A 168-hour return cannot be recorded or counted as a valid 24-hour return.
Do not invent a lateness tolerance or source timestamp, revive retired entry permission, rewrite frozen historical rows or change market rules.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
